description.value: Chancho Tortilleria is an authentic Mexican tortilleria on Vancouver's vibrant Commercial Drive, making fresh tortillas daily from ancient, non-GMO corn sourced directly from small Mexican farms. The menu revolves around tacos, tortas, and tragos (cocktails), with an emphasis on high-quality pork and locally sourced ingredients. The walk-in, no-reservations format makes it a relaxed and accessible stop for cyclists passing through the Drive.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address, phone number, and no-reservations policy. The /order subpage explicitly confirms online pickup ordering and delivery via DoorDash and Uber Eats, establishing takeout as true. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed address, and active menu and ordering system. A solid food stop for cyclists on Commercial Drive.
